desc.id: Panah menunjukkan kata coffee berpindah dari bahasa Arab ke bahasa Turki, ke bahasa Italia, lalu ke bahasa Inggris. Di bawahnya, sebuah pengumuman memakai gambar makanan, jam, kalender dan peta.

Arabic.note: Font-size 20 (was 24) on all four language names so "Bahasa Inggris" fits its box; the four stay the same size.

Hillside Learning Centre.note: Place name, kept as in the lesson.

Fri.note: Usual Indonesian short form of Jumat on calendars; "Jumat" does not fit the circle.

Arrows show the word coffee moving from.back: Arrows show the word coffee moving from Arabic to Turkish, to Italian, then to English. Below it, a notice uses pictures of food, a clock, a calendar and a map.
